name: Ootori Sakuya
source:
Calls himself [url=/c303]Chihaya's[/url] "older brother". While not related to her by blood, he takes care of various things in his stated role as butler. Taking the attitude of a serene older brother while facing [url=/c304]Yoshino[/url] and the female students, for some reason he's coldhearted only to [url=/c267]Kotarou[/url]. With unusual physical ability and knowledge, while having strange connections he puts on a display of calmly providing anything, as a flawless butler.

[spoiler]He is a former Rewrite user as same as Kotarou, who became into a familiar due to overuse of Rewrite ability. His surname is Ootori, because he has formed familiar-master contract with Chihaya, despite not being as a blood or even adoptive brother.[/spoiler]
